name: Never Lonely Again
source:
Based on the children's picture book by Hans Wilhelm, with original illustrations. 

Chestnut the squirrel has no friends. He lives a solitary lifestyle. However, one day he meets Morris the otter and his life changes forever.

[From [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11332]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
改编自汉斯·威廉的儿童绘本，并沿用原作插图。

松鼠栗子没有朋友，一直独自生活。然而，某天他遇见水獭莫里斯，人生从此彻底改变。

[译自 [url=https://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=11332]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
